place.name: Jamaica Center–York College station
place.description: The Jamaica Center–York College station (formerly the Jamaica Center–Parsons Boulevard station and Jamaica Center-Parsons/Archer station and sometimes shortened as the Jamaica Center station) is the northern terminal station of the IND and BMT Archer Avenue Lines of the New York City Subway, located at Parsons Boulevard and Archer Avenue in Jamaica, Queens. It is served by E and J trains at all times, as well as Z trains during rush hours in the peak direction.
